name: billcraft
idea: BillCraft is a free, browser-only professional invoice generator for freelancers and small businesses — fill in your details, add line items with quantity and rate, and download a polished PDF invoice instantly with no signup required.
why_trending: Freelancing and creator-economy micro-businesses are booming in 2026; micro-SaaS reports cite freelancer tooling as a top revenue category ($10K–60K/month MRR). 'Free invoice generator' is among the highest-volume commercial-intent searches (~2M/month), and Product Hunt's June 2026 leaderboard is dominated by productivity tools that shorten the path from idea to output.
why_profitable: Comparable tools (Invoice Ninja, Wave, FreshBooks) charge $15–50/month. A zero-friction free tier captures massive organic SEO traffic; premium unlocks (custom branding, recurring invoices, client portal) or AdSense on the free tier convert well at high CPC ($4–9 for financial keywords).
why_easy: The entire app is a single self-contained HTML/CSS/JS file: form state lives in the DOM, totals compute client-side, the live preview renders with innerHTML, PDF export uses jsPDF via CDN, and drafts persist in localStorage. No server, database, build step, or API key required.
note: Demo stored in idea-queue/demos/billcraft/ because the session token lacks repo-creation permissions. To launch standalone: create github.com/pepegoat/billcraft, copy demos/billcraft/index.html there, enable GitHub Pages.
